response.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, GOT, GPT, APTT, PT FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5), per_status AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(CASE WHEN GOT IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL THEN GOT - GPT END) AS avg_ast_minus_alt, AVG(CASE WHEN APTT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL THEN APTT - PT END) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM filtered GROUP BY CENTROMEA) SELECT AVG(avg_ast_minus_alt) AS avg_ast_minus_alt, AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM per_status;
